versions.content: If less data than expected are handed over to the SOME/IP transformer during deserialization of data, the following shall happen: • if for the corresponding ISignal an initial value is specified (in serialized form) use the value to fill the missing elements at the end of the serialized stream. • if no initial value is available abort deserialization with E_SER_MALFORMED_MESSAGE .
